title: Your Hockey Career | Trailer
caption:
Play every shift yourself. Your Hockey Career is real time 5v5 hockey on your phone, with a full career from a 16 year old rookie to a legend: sign contracts, climb the leagues, win championships, play for your country at the World Championship and the Nations Cup, and retire as a legend.

Coming soon to Google Play. The closed test is open now, join in 3 quick steps: https://finpixelgames.github.io/hockey

Made by FinPixel Games, an indie studio from Finland.
verified: trailer 2026-10-16: AI match footage + career views from the game; all claims match the build 1.0.1 (2)
